description: Defines data structures, classes, and functions for RLC receive metrics in a wireless communication system, including mode-specific metrics for TM, UM, and AM modes, along with formatting utilities.

classes.name: rlc_rx_metrics
classes.description: Holds various metrics related to RLC reception, including mode-specific metrics for TM, UM, and AM modes, and provides methods for resetting and retrieving metrics.

classes.name: rlc_rx_metrics_interface
classes.description: Abstract interface class for RLC receive metrics, defining methods to get, reset, and retrieve metrics.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a copy of the current metrics and increments the internal counter.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all metrics to their initial state.
